svg.title: ARIMA residual and autocorrelation diagnostics
svg.desc: Four generated panels show 240 fictional daily cumulative energy meter readings, their daily changes, and residual autocorrelation through 20 days for two models. The drift-only model has a lag-10 Ljung-Box p-value near 3.03 times 10 to the minus 12 and several large residual correlations. ARIMA 2, 1, 0 has much smaller residual correlations and a lag-10 p-value of 0.083.
